subject: R App works well Locally but doesn't get Published in shinyapps.io

messages.author: 1fafbf9c8432893b
messages.subject: R App works well Locally but doesn't get Published in shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi,

I have created an app, the code for which is present at the end of this question. It works very well locally. The issue is when I try to publish it via shinyapps.io and am unable to do so. I created an account on shinyapps.io and got the code with the token and secret, and connected my RStudio to it. When I try to publish the app the following error appears:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 371701...Error: Unable to retrieve package records for the following packages:
- "GLMMGibbs", "a", "exNSS4", "graph", "myTst", "pkgA", "yags"
In addition: There were 50 or more warnings (use warnings() to see the first 50)
Execution halted

I have tried many things, but it persists. Please do help me with the same. If I need to update or upgrade anything, I'll be glad to. Just need it to work.

The code of the app is:

library(tau)
library(data.table)
library(tm)
library(class)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(NLP)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(shiny)
library(packrat)

if (interactive()) {

  ui <- fluidPage(
    textAreaInput("resumehtml","Resume",width = 800,height=200),
    textAreaInput("jdhtml","Job Description",width = 800,height=200),
    actionButton("add", "Add"),
    h3(textOutput("another")),
    dataTableOutput("value")
  )
  server <- function(input, output,session) {
    observeEvent(input$add, {
    jd <- as.character(input$jdhtml)
    resume <- as.character(input$resumehtml)
    
    jd <- str_replace_all(jd, "[^[:alnum:]]", " ")
    jd.text <- iconv(jd,"ASCII")
    jd.corpus <- Corpus(VectorSource(jd.text))
    term.doc.matrix <- TermDocumentMatrix(jd.corpus,control=list(removePunctuation = TRUE, stopwords=c('for','in','the','on','of','com','with','oyo','Job Description','Job',stopwords('english')),removeNumbers=TRUE,tolower=TRUE))
    term.doc.matrix <- as.matrix(term.doc.matrix)
    word.freq <- sort(rowSums(term.doc.matrix),decreasing=T)
    dm <- data.frame(word=names(word.freq),freq=word.freq)
    
    resume <- str_replace_all(resume, "[^[:alnum:]]", " ")
    resume.text <- iconv(resume,"ASCII")
    resume.corpus <- Corpus(VectorSource(resume.text))
    term.doc.resume <- TermDocumentMatrix(resume.corpus,control=list(removePunctuation = TRUE, stopwords=c('Job Description','Job',stopwords('english')),removeNumbers=TRUE,tolower=TRUE))
    term.doc.resume <- as.matrix(term.doc.resume)
    word.freq.resume <- sort(rowSums(term.doc.resume),decreasing=T)
    dm.resume <- data.frame(word=names(word.freq.resume),freq=word.freq.resume)
    
    rm_words <- function(string, words) {
      stopifnot(is.character(string), is.character(words))
      spltted <- strsplit(string, " ", fixed = TRUE)
      vapply(spltted, function(x) paste(x[!tolower(x) %in% words], collapse = " "), character(1))
    }
    robbie <- rm_words(jd.text, tm::stopwords("en"))
    
    createNgram <-function(stringVector, ngramSize){
      
      ngram <- data.table()
      
      ng <- textcnt(stringVector, method = "string", n=ngramSize, tolower = FALSE)
      
      if(ngramSize==1){
        ngram <- data.table(w1 = names(ng), freq = unclass(ng), length=nchar(names(ng)))  
      }
      else {
        ngram <- data.table(w1w2 = names(ng), freq = unclass(ng), length=nchar(names(ng)))
      }
      return(ngram)
    }
    
    jd.m2 <- createNgram(robbie,2)
    resume.multiple <- createNgram(resume.text,2)
    jd.m22 <- createNgram(jd.text,2)
    jd.m222 = merge(jd.m2[, c("w1w2", "freq")], 
                    jd.m22[, c("w1w2", "freq")])
    
    jd.m3 <- createNgram(robbie,3)
    resume.m3 <- createNgram(resume.text,3)
    jd.m33 <- createNgram(jd.text,3)
    jd.m333 = merge(jd.m3[, c("w1w2", "freq")], 
                    jd.m33[, c("w1w2", "freq")])
    
    final.jd1 <- dm[dm$freq>1,]
    final.jd2 <- jd.m222[jd.m222$freq>1,]
    colnames(final.jd2)[which(names(final.jd2) == "w1w2")] <- "word"
    final.jd3 <- jd.m333[jd.m333$freq>1,]
    colnames(final.jd3)[which(names(final.jd3) == "w1w2")] <- "word"
    final.jd <- rbind(final.jd1,final.jd2,final.jd3,fill=T)
    
    colnames(resume.multiple)[which(names(resume.multiple) == "w1w2")] <- "word"
    colnames(resume.m3)[which(names(resume.m3) == "w1w2")] <- "word"
    final.resume <- rbind(dm.resume,resume.multiple,resume.m3,fill=T)
    
    left_join <- merge(x = final.jd, y = final.resume, by = "word", all.x = TRUE)
    left_join[is.na(left_join)] <- 'Not in Resume'
    colnames(left_join)[which(names(left_join) == "word")] <- "Keyword"
    colnames(left_join)[which(names(left_join) == "freq.x")] <- "Frequency in JD"
    colnames(left_join)[which(names(left_join) == "freq.y")] <- "Frequency in Resume"
    
    jinga <- nrow(left_join[left_join$`Frequency in Resume` == "Not in Resume",])
    totaljinga <- nrow(left_join)
    diffjinga <- totaljinga - jinga
    percjinga <- diffjinga/totaljinga
    fitscore <- round(percjinga * 100)
    
    output$another <- renderText({ paste("FIT SCORE (Match between your Resume and the JD):",fitscore) })
    
    output$value <- renderDataTable(left_join[,1:3])
    })
  }
    
   shinyApp(ui,server)
  }

    jd.m33 <- createNgram(jd.text,3)
    jd.m333 = merge(jd.m3[, c("w1w2", "freq")], 
                    jd.m33[, c("w1w2", "freq")])
    
    final.jd1 <- dm[dm$freq>1,]
    final.jd2 <- jd.m222[jd.m222$freq>1,]
    colnames(final.jd2)[which(names(final.jd2) == "w1w2")] <- "word"
    final.jd3 <- jd.m333[jd.m333$freq>1,]
    colnames(final.jd3)[which(names(final.jd3) == "w1w2")] <- "word"
    final.jd <- rbind(final.jd1,final.jd2,final.jd3,fill=T)
    
    colnames(resume.multiple)[which(names(resume.multiple) == "w1w2")] <- "word"
    colnames(resume.m3)[which(names(resume.m3) == "w1w2")] <- "word"
    final.resume <- rbind(dm.resume,resume.multiple,resume.m3,fill=T)
    
    left_join <- merge(x = final.jd, y = final.resume, by = "word", all.x = TRUE)
    left_join[is.na(left_join)] <- 'Not in Resume'
    colnames(left_join)[which(names(left_join) == "word")] <- "Keyword"
    colnames(left_join)[which(names(left_join) == "freq.x")] <- "Frequency in JD"
    colnames(left_join)[which(names(left_join) == "freq.y")] <- "Frequency in Resume"
    
    jinga <- nrow(left_join[left_join$`Frequency in Resume` == "Not in Resume",])
    totaljinga <- nrow(left_join)
    diffjinga <- totaljinga - jinga
    percjinga <- diffjinga/totaljinga
    fitscore <- round(percjinga * 100)
    
    output$another <- renderText({ paste("FIT SCORE (Match between your Resume and the JD):",fitscore) })
    
    output$value <- renderDataTable(left_join[,1:3])
    })
  }
